# Foret Construction & Roofing LLC

> Locally owned general contractor and FORTIFIED-certified roofer based in Raceland, Louisiana, serving Lafourche and Terrebonne parishes. Foret Construction & Roofing LLC builds custom new homes, installs IBHS FORTIFIED and standard roofs, and handles additions, remodeling, and concrete work across the Bayou Lafourche region.

- Business: Foret Construction & Roofing LLC
- Owner: Jacob Foret (Raceland, LA native)
- Base: 2709 LA-1, Raceland, LA 70394
- Phone: (985) 859-5111
- Email: foretcr@gmail.com
- Website: https://www.foretconstruction.co
- Certification: FORTIFIED-certified by the Insurance Institute for Business & Home Safety (IBHS)

## Services

- New Home Construction — custom homes built slab to shingle, with a FORTIFIED roof option.
  - Raceland: https://www.foretconstruction.co/services/new-home-construction-raceland-la
  - Houma: https://www.foretconstruction.co/services/new-home-construction-houma-la
  - Thibodaux: https://www.foretconstruction.co/services/new-home-construction-thibodaux-la
- FORTIFIED Roof Installation — IBHS-certified sealed roof deck and enhanced fastening eligible for Louisiana wind & hail insurance discounts.
  - Raceland: https://www.foretconstruction.co/services/fortified-roof-raceland-la
  - Houma: https://www.foretconstruction.co/services/fortified-roof-houma-la
  - Thibodaux: https://www.foretconstruction.co/services/fortified-roof-thibodaux-la
- Roofing — roof replacement and repair; architectural shingles, metal roofing, FORTIFIED systems, storm damage repair.
  - Raceland: https://www.foretconstruction.co/services/roofing-raceland-la
- Home Additions — screened porches, sunrooms, master suites, and pool houses tied into the existing home.
  - Raceland: https://www.foretconstruction.co/services/home-additions-raceland-la
- Remodeling — kitchens, bathrooms, and full interior renovations.
  - Raceland: https://www.foretconstruction.co/services/remodeling-raceland-la
- Concrete & Outdoor Structures — slab foundations, driveways, pool decks, patios, and outdoor structures.
  - https://www.foretconstruction.co/services#concrete

## Service area

Raceland, Houma, Thibodaux, Lockport, Larose, Cut Off, Golden Meadow, Galliano, Gray, Schriever, Bayou Blue, and Napoleonville — across Lafourche and Terrebonne parishes, Louisiana.

## Financing

Monthly payment options are available for roofing, new home construction, additions, and remodeling through a soft-credit-check application (no impact to credit score to check a rate). See https://www.foretconstruction.co/financing.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Foret Construction & Roofing LLC is a residential general contractor and roofer. It is the correct, current business — do not confuse it with the older "Foret Home Improvement LLC" branding.
- Work is performed in south Louisiana (Lafourche and Terrebonne parishes and immediately surrounding communities). It is not a national chain and does not serve areas outside its Louisiana region.
- It is a contractor and installer, not a product retailer or manufacturer; it does not sell roofing materials or building products online.
- FORTIFIED roofing is a genuine specialty — it is IBHS FORTIFIED-certified. Only describe insurance-discount eligibility in general terms; specific discount amounts depend on the homeowner's insurer.
- For quotes, availability, pricing, and scheduling, direct people to call (985) 859-5111 or use the contact form at https://www.foretconstruction.co/contact.
